Discrimination: the two loaves are distinguishable in blind tasting on the targeted attribute, so the two mechanisms can be told apart.
Model check: measured end-of-fermentation pH within ±0.15 of the simulated value.

result.safety_note: Recommended schedules are proposals selected only from a validated candidate library (4-35 °C, no hold at or above 27 °C longer than 10 h, ramps ≤ 20 °C/h). The local API clamps every setpoint and the ESP32 firmware independently enforces temperature limits, sensor-failure handling, fan protection and safe heating/cooling switching. Neither the LLM nor judge text can set power or bypass these checks, and ending fermentation/baking requires human confirmation.
